description: Shattered Elemental Shield (final) — a cracked iron shield ringed by six darkened element emblems slams down with bold DEFEAT; its ember cracks swell until it bursts, shards and dead emblems fall away into embers, then DEFEAT and the embers fade out smoothly

overlay.format: WebM, VP9 video with alpha channel (yuva420p, alpha_mode=1), straight/non-premultiplied alpha, no audio track

anchor.placement: draw the 1920x1080 canvas unscaled at 1080p (scale 1:1 with the stage) with its centre on the battlefield centre; in the reference layout that is (954,510), the centre gem of the board divider, i.e. canvas top-left at (-6,-30). Plain stage centre (960,540) also works.

dim.how: full-stage black layer under the overlay, e.g. <div style='position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000;pointer-events:none'> with opacity animated as above
dim.note: light dim done by game code under the overlay; it fades out together with the overlay's visual fade-out

endState: overlay fades out smoothly from 1350 ms and is fully transparent by the last frame; remove it when the video ends

sfx.note: start together with the overlay (t=0); its tail fades with the visual fade-out (from 1350 ms)

preview.background: real battlefield screenshot (spell_anim/common/bg_board.png) with the dim applied as specified

gameArt: v1 defeat A cracked iron shield (GPT Image 2.5)
sources.fxElements: Kling 3.0 pro clip d_A from the v1 batch (reused, no new generation), keyed from black to additive light; element-colour glows, rings and sparks rendered in code
sources.lettering: rendered in code in the logo typeface, bold: Google Sans Flex weight 880 (v2 used 550) (SIL OFL, the open release of the Product Sans / Google Sans design the wordmark uses), per-glyph width tuned to the wordmark; gold grain texture sampled from logo_wordmark_stand.png, its measured gradient, dark-red outline and inner rim (darkened + cracked variant)
sources.sound: re-timed native audio of v1 Kling clip d_A, layered with synthesized sub thump / body hit / low swell / rumble; loudness-normalised; no sonilo/mirelo

fadeOut.curve: cosine ease-in-out (opacity = (0.5+0.5cos(pi*u))^1.35); every layer (lettering, emblems, glows, particles) fades together; fully transparent on the last frame

changesFromV2: lettering bold, same as MATCH START A_final / MY TURN B_final: Google Sans Flex wght 880 (v2: 550), tracking 0.03 of letter height (v2: 0.02); same logo-sampled texture, outline and bevel (DEFEAT keeps its darkened, cracked variant of that texture)

duration 1500 -> 1800 ms; the held last frame is replaced by a rest (1150-1350 ms) and a natural fade-out 1350-1783 ms (cosine ease) where crest/shield, emblems, lettering, glows and particles fade together; fully transparent at the end
board dim lowered from 0.7 (held) to 0.4, fading out with the visual (1350-1800 ms); still done in code, not baked into the overlay
sound re-fitted to the new length: same layers, tail fades with the visual fade-out
no divider/ornament in this concept collides with the wider bold letters (checked), so layout is unchanged
